summary: All four artifacts (research.json, materials.json, sop_modules.json, production.json) are structurally sound, doctrine-compliant, and internally consistent. No critical or major issues found. Two warnings: (1) brief.md still lists 'spray' as an application_method value despite RC-005 removing it from all spec artifacts, (2) RC-005 lacks formal doctrine_assignment with target_doc. Human feedback was applied inline via Dev Orchestrator conversation (fixture correction, spray-only removal). Spray/backroll coupling constraint is properly declared. PaintScope keys verified. Protection zone pairing is complete. Adjacency declarations cover all four required surfaces.

issues.description: Brief (specs/_backlog/SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME/brief.md) Section 3 still lists 'spray' as a valid application_method value. All spec artifacts correctly removed spray-only per RC-005, but the brief is now out of sync.
issues.suggested_fix: Update brief Section 3 application_method to remove 'spray', leaving only 'roll, spray_backroll'. Add note that spray-only was removed per RC-005.

issues.description: RC-005 (spray-only never valid for drywall prime) is captured in research.json and production.json research_corrections arrays, but lacks a formal doctrine_assignment with target_doc pointing to a doctrine file for codification.
issues.suggested_fix: Add doctrine_assignment to RC-005 in research.json with target_doc: 'docs/Doctrine/Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine.md' or create a new doctrine note. Alternatively, acknowledge as stakeholder directive that doesn't require doctrine codification.

issues.description: Fixture protection module MOD_PROTECT_FIXTURES_WALL_SPRAY applies_when spray_backroll only. Cover removal (TSK_WALL_REMOVE_COVERS_REGISTERS) has method_dependent: false, suggesting it should apply to all methods, but the parent module restricts it to spray_backroll. If rolling, outlet covers left on may get paint on cover edges.
issues.suggested_fix: Evaluate whether cover removal should be a separate module that applies to all application_methods. Current scope is defensible for NC prime (covers can stay on for roll since roller splatter is minimal), but flag for wall finish spec consideration.

feedback_log.description: Fixture protection approach: outlet covers/switch plates REMOVED (not masked), HVAC registers removed and labeled, light fixtures loosened and masked, no reinstallation during prime phase

review_notes: Wall prime spec follows ceiling prime structural patterns with appropriate wall-specific adjustments (faster rates, no overhead fatigue, different edge perspective).
Per-room heuristic for fixture removal is a practical field approach. PS_META.EA.ROOMS_TOTAL exists in PaintScope catalog and mapping.
RC-005 represents a significant stakeholder directive that should be propagated to doctrine. Currently enforced at spec level only.
Brief needs update to remove 'spray' from application_method — this is a brief maintenance item, not a spec defect.

Spray/backroll coupling is properly declared with COUPLE_SPRAY_BACKROLL_WALL constraint. Individual task rates (spray 600, backroll 400) are capability rates; effective system rate is 400 per coupling rule.
